about_the_game:
About the Game

Explore the world of Silverdawn in an exciting, Hungarian-dubbed 2D platformer action game! Uncover the mystery behind the chaos and darkness that have plagued these lands. Embark on a journey with Alrik, reveal hidden secrets, and face the forces of evil to restore order to the shattered kingdom.

Key Features:

Thrilling Universe – Traverse the lush lands of Silverdawn all the way to the frozen fortress of Isenberg in a captivating 1-hour adventure.

Blend of Action and Skill – Defend yourself with your bow against the most dangerous creatures of hell and overcome deadly obstacles.

Unique Story and Characters – Meet a variety of characters who aid you on your quest as you uncover the secrets of the monarchy.

Visuals and Atmosphere – A hand-drawn medieval fantasy world awaits, where enchanting landscapes hide lurking dangers.

Epic Soundtrack – Featuring music by AlkaKrab, Random Mind, Storyum, and Zöld Bálint, blending medieval and modern compositions to enhance the game's atmosphere and epic feel.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or newer, or another modern 64-bit Linux distribution (e.g., Fedora, Arch)
  • Processor: Dual-core, dual-threaded CPU (e.g., Intel Core 2 Duo, AMD Athlon X2, or better)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or AMD Radeon Vega 3 or better (Mesa 20.0+ recommended)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan support or OpenGL 3.3 compatibility
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, or another modern 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750, AMD Radeon HD 7770, or better (Proprietary or Mesa drivers recommended)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan support or OpenGL 4.5 compatibility

short_description: Tales of Isenberg is a medieval fantasy-style, Hungarian-voiced 2D platformer that blends action and skill. The hero, Alrik, journeys to the frozen castle of Isenberg to face the forces of darkness. Dangerous foes and unexpected twists await you!
supported_languages:
English, Hungarian*, Slovak
*languages with full audio support
